title: Three bullseyes: you hit every dart and the arena goes wild
summary: Turn one photo of you into a darts final: three throws, three bullseyes, then a big celebration as a packed arena roars.
why: SameButMe added a "Darts Filter" AI video to its rising November 2026 trends list on November 16. In it, a darts player lands three bullseyes and celebrates in front of an arena crowd; the example clip it links has about 2.2 million TikTok plays.
steps: Pick a clear, well-lit photo of you from the waist up, facing the camera or side-on.
Upload it to an image-to-video tool and paste the main prompt.
Generate a few versions. Keep the one where the darts land cleanly and your face stays like you.
Add a loud crowd sound or a trending audio, and caption it with your own small win.

prompts.label: Main prompt: the perfect three
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo as the darts player. They stand at the oche in a big, dark arena, lit by a bright stage spotlight, with a glowing dartboard in front of them. They throw three darts, one after another, in a calm, smooth motion. Each dart lands dead centre in the bullseye with a small thud. After the third, they turn to the camera, throw both arms up and shout with joy. Behind them, a packed crowd jumps to its feet, cheering and waving. Keep their face, hair and clothes the same as the photo. Realistic sports-broadcast look, slight slow motion on the last dart, 8 seconds.

prompts.label: Variation: the pub-league legend
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo as the darts player in a cosy neighbourhood pub on a winter night. Wood panels, string lights, a few friends at a table behind them. They throw three darts and every one hits the bullseye. Their friends leap up, spill a bit of their drinks and hug them. Warm, grainy phone-video look, natural light, 8 seconds. Keep their face and clothes the same.

prompts.label: Variation: your pet throws
prompts.text: Use the pet in this photo as the darts player. It stands on its back legs on a little box at the oche in a bright arena, holding a dart in its paw. It throws three darts and each lands in the bullseye. Then it spins in a happy circle while the crowd cheers and confetti falls. Cute and funny, realistic fur and lighting, 8 seconds. Keep the pet's markings the same.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: we nailed it
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo, wearing a plain apron or work shirt, as the darts player in a big arena. On the dartboard, three simple text labels sit around the bullseye: [your three strengths, like "On time", "Local", "Fair price"]. They throw three darts and each one hits the bullseye as a label lights up. They celebrate and the crowd cheers. Clean, bright sports-broadcast look, 8 seconds. No logos or brand names on clothes or screens.

tips: A side-on photo with your throwing arm visible gives the smoothest throw.
If the darts miss or bend, add "darts fly straight and stick in the board" and try again.
Keep crowd faces blurry and unrecognisable. Use only your own photo or a friend who agreed.
Businesses: only put real, true strengths on the board. No made-up awards or results.
